text: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and astounding: seven angels holding seven plagues — the last ones, for with them the wrath of God is completed.

versions.text: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and astounding: seven angels holding seven plagues — the last ones, for with them the wrath of God is brought to completion.
versions.explanation: The Greek verb ἐτελέσθη is a simple aorist passive; "is brought to completion" is wordy for oral reading, and the shorter "is completed" reads more smoothly while matching "were completed" in verse 8.

text: And I saw what looked like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and standing on the sea of glass were those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name, holding harps given them by God.
And they sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb: "Great and astounding are your works, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of the ages.

versions.text: And they sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb: "Great and astounding are your works, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of the nations.
versions.explanation: The Greek text here reads αἰώνων ("ages"), not ἐθνῶν ("nations"). "King of the ages" also avoids an awkward duplication with "all the nations" in verse 4. A footnote may note that some manuscripts read "nations."

text: Who will not fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you alone are holy. All the nations will come and worship before you, for your righteous acts have been revealed."
After this I looked, and the temple — the tent of witness — was opened in heaven,
and out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues, dressed in clean, shining linen and wearing golden sashes across their chests.
Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls filled with the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
